about: Test vectors for the CEL extension normalize(text), shared so that any implementation of Miqyas claims can run them. Each vector has an input and the expected output; both are written as JSON escapes so that no editor changes them. The rules are in docs/cel-subset.md. Expected values were worked out by hand from those rules and the Unicode character names, not produced by the code.

vectors.name: ASCII capitals fold to lower case
Latin capital with an accent
a letter and a combining accent compose (Unicode form NFKC)
the precomposed and the decomposed accent give the same text
the fi ligature unfolds
full-width letters become ordinary letters
sharp s is lower case already and is not folded to ss
capital I with dot above lowers to i and a combining dot above
Greek capital sigma at the end of a word lowers to the final form
Greek capitals
Arabic short vowels, shadda and sukun are removed
Arabic tanween is removed
the Arabic superscript alef and a sukun are removed
tatweel is removed
alef with hamza above becomes alef
alef with hamza below becomes alef
alef with madda above becomes alef
alef wasla becomes alef
alef maqsura becomes yeh
teh marbuta becomes heh
Persian kaf becomes Arabic kaf
Persian yeh becomes Arabic yeh
hamza on waw and hamza on yeh are left alone
Arabic-Indic digits are left alone
the lam-alef-madda presentation form unfolds to lam and alef
the Allah ligature unfolds to its letters
a full name with vowels, hamza and spacing
Arabic and English in one string
runs of spaces, tabs and line breaks become one space, and the ends are trimmed
a no-break space is a space
an ideographic space and an em space are spaces
a zero-width space is removed
a zero-width non-joiner and joiner are removed
a byte order mark and direction marks are removed
a soft hyphen is removed
the empty text stays empty
only spaces gives the empty text
